Updated references and file paths for AI-generated research notebooks. Enhanced CLI styling with UTF-8 support, added `cli_coprime` message type, and optimized 256-color detection for cross-platform compatibility.

Update scriber-core submodule URL and clean up CI
- Change scriber-core submodule URL from eigenscribe to The-Scriber-Experience - Remove Eigenscribe Doctor diagnostics step from CI pipeline - Fix TSE module source folder configuration in IDE settings

Add scriber-core as a core dependency
- Require scriber-core>=1.0.0 in pyproject.toml - Sync uv.lock with new dependency and its transitive packages

Refine CLI style presets and update practice problem checklist
- Replace hardcoded hex color values in cli/style.py gradient presets with named constants from scriber_core.frontend.colors.COLOR_PALETTE and scriber_core.frontend.gradients.GRADIENT_PRESETS - Mark completed tasks in section-c1.md practice problem checklist - Fix color name typo in scriber_core/frontend/colors.py (neon_green → brigh_green) and adjust neon_green hex value

Refresh coprime coding task notebook and CLI gradient presets
- Replace hardcoded gradient preset references with named presets (eigenscribe-1, green_gradient) in problem-16-coding-task.ipynb and add styled output formatting for Extended GCD trace - Register green_gradient preset from GRADIENT_PRESETS in cli/style.py gradient map - Update notebook execution timestamps and benchmark data files

Centralize visualization colors from scriber_core palette and extend color registry
- Replace hardcoded hex literals in analysis/viz.py design tokens and PROJECT_COLORS with named lookups from scriber_core.frontend.COLOR_PALETTE - Add new color entries to COLOR_PALETTE (greens, purples, oranges, neutrals) - Add Problem 17 on CRT reconstruction to section-c1.md practice problems

Update .idea/workspace.xml and .scriber-core submodule reference

Update Problem 16 notebook gradient presets and clean up IDE workspace
- Replace hardcoded gradient preset references (purple_gradient, green_gradient) with named presets (eigenscribe-1, eigenscribe-2) in the Extended GCD trace output in problem-16-coding-task.ipynb - Remove stale .idea/kuramoto-dash-app.iml module file - Update .idea/workspace.xml task history and recent run configuration

Refactor CLI style module into Scriber Core 4-layer token subpackage
- Split monolithic style.py into kuramoto/cli/style/ package with types, palettes, color_utils, gradients, layout, messages, and domain modules - Migrate color palettes to scriber_core.frontend.colors imports - Add TrueColor gradient engine with eigenscribe-1/2 presets - Add benchmark results and validation plot artifacts

docs: complete Problem 16 coding task notebook with Bézout's Identity exercises
